  voila search <query> [--page-size <n>] [--page-token <token>] [--session <path>] [--json]

entries.rationale: Group help is resolved before subcommand validation, and the successful help output includes the current keepalive and JSON login usage.
Successful group help carries only stdout, so the impossible stderr channel is omitted.
CliRunResult now carries exactly one output channel; omitted stderr is intentional for the JSON failure variant.
CliRunResult now carries exactly one output channel; omitted stdout is intentional for the text failure variant.
